ruleContent: @js:(function(){var html=String(result);var urls=[];var re=/video_(?:alt_)?url\d*:\s*'([^']+)'/g;var m;while((m=re.exec(html))!==null){if(m[1]&&urls.indexOf(m[1])===-1)urls.push(m[1]);}function q(u){var x=u.match(/[_\-](\d{3,4})p?\.mp4/);return x?parseInt(x[1]):0;}if(urls.length===0)return '';var lows=urls.filter(function(u){return q(u)>0&&q(u)<=1080;}).sort(function(a,b){return q(b)-q(a);});return lows.length>0?lows[0]:urls.sort(function(a,b){return q(a)-q(b);})[0];})()
